title: GmbH-Gesetz §§ 30g and 40 and Aktiengesetz §§ 92 and 120: the Niederschrift of a supervisory board and of a general meeting
source: GmbH-Gesetz (https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10001720) and Aktiengesetz (https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10002070), consolidated federal law as of 2026-10-09, read on RIS that day.

rules.text: A Niederschrift is drawn up of the supervisory board's proceedings and resolutions and signed by its chair or the deputy.
The resolutions of a GmbH's general meeting are entered in a Niederschrift without delay.
A copy of the resolutions, stating the day they were entered in the Niederschrift, goes to every shareholder by registered letter without delay; the Niederschrift states that day.
The Niederschriften and the resolutions passed in writing are kept in order, and every shareholder may read them during business hours.
A resolution of an Aktiengesellschaft's general meeting is valid only as a notary records it; a file written here is a working record and the reply says so.
